stories.headline: Decade-long efforts averted energy crisis during war: PM Narendra Modi
stories.title: Decade-long efforts averted energy crisis during war: PM Narendra Modi
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday said steps taken in the last decade helped the country to sail through the crisis emerged during the war in the Middle East. He was inaugurating various welfare projects worth over Rs 15,600 crore here, including renewable energy and petroleum infrastructure. "War around Iran and Gulf countries shows how important energy security is. Steps taken for energy security in the last decade helped the country face the crisis with resilience," the PM said. Regarding the Metro Pink Line, which was dedicated to the public, Modi said it gives better connectivity to people in Bengaluru. He also noted that the Metro rail network increased from 17 km in 2014 to over 100 km in 2026 in Bengaluru. On the occasion, Modi lauded Karnataka Governor Sudha Yadav for serving the nation as the widow of a Kargil war hero.

stories.headline: Another cyclone forms in Bay of Bengal, likely to intensify by Nov 15
stories.title: Another cyclone forms in Bay of Bengal, likely to intensify by Nov 15
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) reports a low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal that is expected to intensify into a depression by November 15, bringing squally weather and 50–60 kmph winds over the Andaman Sea and nearby regions.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) reports a low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal that is expected to intensify into a depression by November 15, bringing squally weather and 50–60 kmph winds over the Andaman Sea and nearby regions.
NEW DELHI: A low-pressure area has formed over the southeast Bay of Bengal and is likely to intensify into a depression by November 15, the IMD said on Friday.
The system formed at 5.30 am under the influence of an upper-air cyclonic circulation over the central Andaman Sea and adjoining Andaman and Nicobar Islands, according to the latest weather update.
"The low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal is likely to move northwestwards and intensify into a depression by November 15," it said.
It is likely to move northwestwards and become a well-marked low-pressure area around November 14 before intensifying into a depression over the same region, it said.

Under its influence, squally weather with wind speeds of about 50 kmph, gusting up to 60 kmph, is likely over the Andaman Sea on November 13 and 14 and over the southeast Bay of Bengal from November 13 to 16.
